correctness.rationale: At each vertex of C5 exactly five balls contain it: its singleton, three radius-one centered neighbor/self/neighbor balls, and all vertices. Independent selection of one averaging row per output vertex linearizes ||M f||² as the maximum of ||Aσ f||² over 5^5=3125 nonnegative matrices; a Perron nonnegative top singular vector justifies exchanging maxima. With B=15A, the condition ||A||²<5/3 is exactly positive definiteness of integer 375I−B^TB. I independently implemented Bareiss fraction-free determinant and verified five leading Sylvester minors for each matrix: 3120 strict and precisely five exceptional rotations. For the representative, sympy exactly verified characteristic polynomial u(u−2)(u³−19u²+62u−36) for H=(3A)^T(3A). Its Perron root λ>5/3 is the unique root of 81λ³−171λ²+62λ−4 in (1.670,1.671), with positive eigenvector (a,1,a,c,c), a=(27λ−2)/D and c=(9λ−2)/D. Independent numerical strict checks for all twenty competing averaging rows confirm this matrix is active; packaged interval inequalities provide rational certification of activity. Simplicity and the strict gap exclude all other equality rays, while independent signs on input are irrelevant. This is a genuinely exhaustive *finite* proof of C5, not a claim for other graphs.
residual_risks: The computed exhaustive determinant is specific to graph-metric *balls*, not arbitrary arcs.
Extremizers are all real inputs up to independent sign changes and cyclic rotations, not arbitrary complex phases.

González-Riquelme–Madrid 2020 introduce uncentered notation but their sharp ℓ² theorems concern centered star/complete graph families; their variation theorems are not this norm. value.rationale: The five-cycle is a canonical smallest noncomplete odd cycle and a natural test case for unrestricted ball centers. Determining an exact algebraic strong ℓ² constant and the *complete* equality rays is mathematically meaningful: it exposes the rigid optimal concentration pattern and distinguishes uncentered and centered graph maximal operators. A complete five-vertex exhaustive certificate qualifies as an exact natural invariant, not an arbitrary or failed infinite conjecture.
residual_risks: No longer cycles, weighted graphs or ℓᵖ other than p=2.

limitations: Unweighted C5, shortest-path balls, counting measure, ℓ² real input and exactly five nonnegative rays.
No claim of computer formalization or independent external attestation.
